description: MobX is a state management library for JavaScript and React that makes state observable, so computed values and components update automatically when it changes. Use when a user asks to add MobX to a React app, create a store with makeAutoObservable, wrap components in observer, write computed values, actions, reactions or flow, fix a MobX component that does not re-render, or migrate from MobX 6 to MobX 7.
